description: Whether Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies to a sole trader or landlord, and from when - qualifying income (self-employment and property income before expenses) over £50,000, £30,000 or £20,000 - with the first year's quarterly update and tax return dates. Use for 'do I need Making Tax Digital', 'when do my quarterly updates start'.

property.description: Property income before expenses (rent before costs), a year, in pounds - their share of anything owned with someone. Defaults to 0.

qualifyingIncome2024.description: Qualifying income in 2024/25, if it wasn't the yearly figures above - it decides 6 April 2026. Optional.

qualifyingIncome2025.description: Qualifying income in 2025/26, if it wasn't the yearly figures above - it decides 6 April 2027. Optional.

qualifyingIncome2026.description: Qualifying income in 2026/27, if it wasn't the yearly figures above - it decides 6 April 2028. Optional.

selfEmployment.description: Self-employment income before expenses (turnover), a year, in pounds. Defaults to 0.
